summary: Flat quiet residential kerb, but homes sit about 10 m away all round.
reasons: Homes within about 12 m on this side
Quiet street, a few cars parked

drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs; a few cars park on the street, but no sleeping convention.
